summary.text: Deanna Gordon, listed by Ballotpedia as Deanna Frazier Gordon, is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 81 who has served since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Deanna Frazier Gordon was born in Richmond, Kentucky.

She earned a bachelor of science in communication disorders from Eastern Kentucky University, a master's degree in communication disorders from the University of Cincinnati, and a doctor of audiology from the Arizona School of Health Sciences.
Her career experience includes working as an audiologist, and she has been a member of the Richmond Chamber of Commerce.
Frazier Gordon took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2019, succeeding C. Wesley Morgan.

In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Banking and Insurance Committee, the Health and Family Services Committee, and the Tourism and Outdoor Recreation Committee, and she chairs the Small Business and Information Technology Committee.
